capabilities: Chat with notes through a configured AI service
Surface related notes while reading with Pagelet
Draft articles and generate images from note material
Capture thoughts to a daily note, inbox, or current note
Prepare article drafts and media for Ghost
disambiguation: Not a task or reminder assistant; its work is AI chat, note retrieval, and generating written and visual content.
extras: Open source (AGPL-3.0-only from 2.8.0); AI usage is billed by the chosen provider. Memory is on by default and sends permitted note text to the provider. Voice features are planned but not available, and the old plugin/theme management tools are retired.
motivation: To let users capture lightly and have the right notes return when they matter, turning reading and thinking into work they can keep and share.
problem: Notes pile up faster than they are revisited, so earlier reading and thinking rarely informs current work.

relations.evidence: The desktop @blog2ghost workflow can prepare article drafts and media with your configured Ghost credentials.
Desktop graph popovers need Hover Editor

requires.name: AI service API key (OpenAI, DashScope, or OpenAI-compatible)

summary: AI assistant that chats with your notes, surfaces related notes while you read, and drafts articles, images and share cards.
